items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Barry White and Isaac are gone. We’re redoing A Secret Garden now. Barry White’s still on it

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Then you lose Isaac Hayes same day about . . .

Barry White and Isaac are gone. We’re redoing A Secret Garden now. Barry White’s still on it, but they’re doing it with Usher, John Mayer, and Kevin Campbell. The hip-hoppers are doing a tribute to me. They’re doing my tunes. It’s been interesting. [?]’s doing Ironside.
